correctness.rationale: One-to-one enumeration of 1,278,686 faces; 639,283 paired and 120 critical (60,41,11,8), complete acyclicity on all matched upper faces, exact integer Morse differentials (60x41,41x11,11x8), compositions zero, Smith factors all 1 at ranks (31,10,1). Independent reverse toggle matching also completely acyclic (639,293 pairs) and has Smith factors all units at ranks (16,11,5); this proves full reduced integral homology and no torsion. Machine source, signed matrices and output are embedded.

originality.rationale: Feng and Wang 2024 Table 1 already computes the rank pair (29,7); Feng 2026 proves all rational ranks but explicitly poses integral torsion-freeness as open. The new full integer Smith calculation establishes the absence of every possible torsion prime at k=1, not implied by ranks over Q or the auxiliary F2 computation. Targeted scientific-record and full-primary-text comparisons found no implication-equivalent integral result. A prior unindexed calculation remains a risk.
residual_risks: An independent integral Smith calculation could exist outside inspected indexed literature.
The large finite proof relies on reproducible machine enumeration and integer algebra, not a concise conceptual classification.
Nothing here settles torsion-freeness for k at least two or determines homotopy type.

value.rationale: The 2026 primary paper explicitly poses integral torsion-freeness for the triple Kneser independence family. The first nontrivial case k=1 is a natural exact 35-vertex object also interpretable as a constant-weight Rips complex; its integer Smith normal forms exclude torsion of every prime, information not determined by previously tabulated rank values 29 and 7. This is an exact, motivated finite resolution of the first case, without claiming a general theorem or homotopy type.
